description.en: Faster walking, running, sprinting, dodges, jumps, wall runs, ladders and attacks: one speed for every move, or a speed for each. Higher jumps. A left stick curve that lets you walk, stick dead zones, auto sprint, or no sprint at all. Realism: no sideways glide, smooth slowdowns, heavier starts.
description.zh-Hans: 更快的行走、奔行、快速奔行、闪避、跳跃、跑墙、爬梯和攻击：所有动作使用同一速度，或为每个动作单独设置速度。跳得更高。左摇杆曲线让行走更容易，可调整摇杆死区，并支持自动快速奔行，也可关闭快速奔行。真实感：转弯不再侧滑，平稳减速，起步更沉稳。

help.en: Off: every move and attack plays at the game's own speed, jumps keep the game's height, and the sticks, the sprint, turns, starts and slowdowns work as in the game.
help.zh-Hans: 关闭：所有动作和攻击恢复游戏原有速度，跳跃恢复游戏原有高度，摇杆、快速奔行、转弯、起步和减速均恢复游戏原有设定。

help.en: The speed of every move set to Global below. 1 is the game's own speed, 3 three times as fast. Dodges stop at 2.5.
help.zh-Hans: 下方设为“全局”的所有动作的速度。1 为游戏原有速度，3 为三倍速度。闪避最高为 2.5。

help.en: Global: same speed as the Global row. 1.0 is the game's own speed, 3.0 three times as fast. Walking, with the stick pushed a little.
help.zh-Hans: 全局：与“全局”行的速度相同。1.0 为游戏原有速度，3.0 为三倍速度。行走（轻推摇杆）。

help.en: Global: same speed as the Global row. 1.0 is the game's own speed, 3.0 three times as fast. Running, the usual pace.
help.zh-Hans: 全局：与“全局”行的速度相同。1.0 为游戏原有速度，3.0 为三倍速度。奔行，平时的移动速度。

help.en: Global: same speed as the Global row. 1.0 is the game's own speed, 3.0 three times as fast. Sprinting, and the high-speed sprint that follows after about 2 seconds.
help.zh-Hans: 全局：与“全局”行的速度相同。1.0 为游戏原有速度，3.0 为三倍速度。快速奔行，以及约 2 秒后进入的疾速奔行。

help.en: Global: same speed as the Global row. 1.0 is the game's own speed, 2.5 two and a half times as fast. Chained dodges play faster. A single dodge lasts as long as before and covers more ground. Global stops at 2.5 here too: any faster and the next dodge can't be chained in time.
help.zh-Hans: 全局：与“全局”行的速度相同。1.0 为游戏原有速度，2.5 为 2.5 倍速度。连续闪避会更快。单次闪避持续时间不变，但移动距离更远。设为“全局”时同样最高 2.5：再快就来不及接上下一次闪避。

help.en: Global: same speed as the Global row. 1.0 is the game's own speed, 3.0 three times as fast. Running up a wall, a pole or a column.
help.zh-Hans: 全局：与“全局”行的速度相同。1.0 为游戏原有速度，3.0 为三倍速度。沿墙壁、杆子或柱子向上奔跑。

help.en: Global: same speed as the Global row. 1.0 is the game's own speed, 3.0 three times as fast. Running along a wall and the jump off at its end.
help.zh-Hans: 全局：与“全局”行的速度相同。1.0 为游戏原有速度，3.0 为三倍速度。沿墙壁横向奔跑，以及在尽头跃离墙面。

help.en: Global: same speed as the Global row. 1.0 is the game's own speed, 3.0 three times as fast. Climbing up and down ladders.
help.zh-Hans: 全局：与“全局”行的速度相同。1.0 为游戏原有速度，3.0 为三倍速度。上下攀爬梯子。

help.en: Global: same speed as the Global row. 1.0 is the game's own speed, 3.0 three times as fast. Ropes, slides, ledges, obstacles and gaps you squeeze through. The swing on a rope keeps the game's own pace.
help.zh-Hans: 全局：与“全局”行的速度相同。1.0 为游戏原有速度，3.0 为三倍速度。绳索、滑行、攀越、翻越障碍和钻过缝隙。绳索摆荡保持游戏原有速度。

help.en: Global: same speed as the Global row. 1.0 is the game's own speed, 3.0 three times as fast. Drawing and putting away your weapon.
help.zh-Hans: 全局：与“全局”行的速度相同。1.0 为游戏原有速度，3.0 为三倍速度。拔出和收起武器。

help.en: Global: same speed as the Global row. 1.0 is the game's own speed, 3.0 three times as fast. Going into and out of the stance.
help.zh-Hans: 全局：与“全局”行的速度相同。1.0 为游戏原有速度，3.0 为三倍速度。进入和退出架势。

help.en: How fast your attacks play. 1 is the game's own speed, 3 three times as fast. Parries, perfect dodges and executions keep the game's own speed.
help.zh-Hans: 攻击动作的速度。1 为游戏原有速度，3 为三倍速度。完美格挡、完美闪避和处决保持游戏原有速度。

help.en: How high you jump from the ground. 1 is the game's own height, 3 three times as high. A higher jump stays a little longer in the air: 1.3 times as long at 3.
help.zh-Hans: 从地面起跳的高度。1 为游戏原有高度，3 为三倍高度。跳得越高，滞空时间会稍长：高度为 3 倍时，滞空时间为 1.3 倍。

help.en: Global: same speed as the Global row. 1.0 is the game's own speed, 5.0 five times as fast. How soon you can attack or dodge after jumping: the game's jump step is this many times shorter. It does not change the height or the time in the air.
help.zh-Hans: 全局：与“全局”行的速度相同。1.0 为游戏原有速度，5.0 为五倍速度。跳跃后多快可以攻击或闪避：游戏的跳跃阶段按此倍数缩短。不改变跳跃高度和滞空时间。

help.en: How the left stick sets your pace. Game: you run from about halfway. Smooth: you walk until about three quarters of the stick, at a speed that follows your push. Custom: the four rows below.
help.zh-Hans: 左摇杆如何决定移动速度。游戏原有：推到约一半即开始奔行。平滑：推到约四分之三前都是行走，速度随推动幅度变化。自定义：使用下方四项设置。

help.en: Custom only. How much of the stick's travel, in percent, does nothing. The game's is 25. At 0, a worn stick can move your character by itself.
help.zh-Hans: 仅在“自定义”模式下有效。摇杆行程中不起作用的百分比。游戏原有为 25。设为 0 时，磨损的摇杆可能让角色自行移动。

help.en: Custom only. How far you push the stick, in percent of its travel, before you run. The game's is about 57.
help.zh-Hans: 仅在“自定义”模式下有效。摇杆推到行程的百分之多少开始奔行。游戏原有约为 57。

help.en: Custom only. Your speed at the lightest push, in percent of the game's walk; the run starts slower too. 100: the game's speeds at any push.
help.zh-Hans: 仅在“自定义”模式下有效。轻推摇杆时的速度，为游戏原有行走速度的百分比；奔行起步也会相应放慢。100：任何推动幅度都使用游戏原有速度。

help.en: Custom only. 1: the speed grows evenly with your push. Higher: more of the stick's travel for the slow speeds. Under 1: the speed rises quickly from a light push.
help.zh-Hans: 仅在“自定义”模式下有效。1：速度随推动幅度均匀增加。更高：更多摇杆行程用于低速。低于 1：轻推即可快速提速。

help.en: How much of the right stick's travel, in percent, does nothing before the camera turns. Smaller: the camera starts turning sooner. Game: the game's own, 20.
help.zh-Hans: 镜头转动前右摇杆行程中不起作用的百分比。越小，镜头越早开始转动。游戏原有：保持游戏设定（20）。

help.en: Sprint: no sprint at all, so no high-speed sprint either. High-speed sprint: you still sprint, but the high-speed sprint that follows 2 seconds of sprint (Thousand-Mile Stride skill) never starts. None: both as in the game. Auto and toggle sprint do nothing while the sprint is off.
help.zh-Hans: 快速奔行：完全无法快速奔行，因此也不会进入疾速奔行。疾速奔行：仍可快速奔行，但 2 秒后不会进入疾速奔行（技能“日行千里”）。无：两者均保持游戏原有设定。关闭快速奔行时，自动和切换快速奔行不起作用。

help.en: Seconds of sprint before the high-speed sprint starts (Thousand-Mile Stride skill). The game's is 2. Does nothing while Turn off sprint turns the high-speed sprint off.
help.zh-Hans: 快速奔行多少秒后进入疾速奔行（技能“日行千里”）。游戏原有为 2 秒。“关闭快速奔行”关闭疾速奔行时不起作用。

help.en: Game: hold the dodge button, as in the game. Auto: tilt the left stick all the way (tilted, not pressed in) to sprint; on the keyboard, you sprint whenever you move. Toggle: press the button picked below to start sprinting, press it again to stop; letting go of the stick stops it too. The game's walk key (Left Alt by default) stops auto and toggle sprint, and holding the dodge button still works.
help.zh-Hans: 游戏原有：与游戏相同，长按闪避键。自动：将左摇杆倾斜到底即可快速奔行（只需倾斜，无需按下）；使用键盘时，只要移动就会快速奔行。切换：按下方选择的按键开始快速奔行，再按一次停止；松开摇杆也会停止。游戏自带的“慢速移动”键（默认左 Alt）会停止自动和切换快速奔行，长按闪避键仍然可用。

help.en: Auto only. Auto sprint stops when the left stick goes back under this percent of its travel.
help.zh-Hans: 仅在“自动”模式下有效。左摇杆回到行程的此百分比以下时，自动快速奔行停止。

label.zh-Hans: 切换快速奔行按键（手柄）

help.en: Toggle only. The controller button that starts and stops the sprint. Its own action in the game happens too: pick one you do not use, or move that action elsewhere with a remapping tool. None: no button.
help.zh-Hans: 仅在“切换”模式下有效。用于开始和停止快速奔行的手柄按键。该按键在游戏中原有的功能也会同时触发：请选择不常用的按键，或用改键模组把该功能移到其他按键上。无：不使用手柄按键。

label.zh-Hans: 切换快速奔行按键（键盘）

help.en: Toggle only. The key or mouse button that starts and stops the sprint. Its own action in the game happens too: pick one you do not use, or move that action elsewhere with a remapping tool. None: no key.
help.zh-Hans: 仅在“切换”模式下有效。用于开始和停止快速奔行的键盘按键或鼠标按键。该按键在游戏中原有的功能也会同时触发：请选择不常用的按键，或用改键模组把该功能移到其他按键上。无：不使用键盘按键。

help.en: After running up a wall, climbing onto a ledge or a dodge on the ground, if you keep the left stick tilted forward (tilted, not pressed in), you run on at full speed as soon as the game gives you control back, instead of starting again from a standstill. The high-speed sprint is kept too. The game's own pause at the end of a rope or of a run along a wall stays.
help.zh-Hans: 向上跑墙、攀越边缘或地面闪避之后，只要左摇杆一直向前倾斜（只需倾斜，无需按下），游戏一恢复操控，你就以全速继续奔行，而不是从静止重新起步。疾速奔行也会保留。荡绳和横向跑墙结束时，游戏自带的停顿仍会保留。

help.en: The end of a dodge on the ground plays faster, so you get control back sooner. Off: it plays at the speed of the Dodges row.
help.zh-Hans: 地面闪避的落地动作播放得更快，操控更早恢复。关闭：按“闪避”行的速度播放。

help.en: Realistic: your character runs where it faces, with no sideways glide in turns, and slows from a sprint to a run or from a run to a walk in under half a second instead of at once. Hyper realistic: the same, and while you run freely (no enemy locked, out of fights) your character also takes half as long again to get up to speed, turns its body more slowly and loses up to 15% of its speed in the sharpest turns, back within half a second. Your top speeds, stops and dodges stay as they are. None: as in the game.
help.zh-Hans: 写实：角色朝面向的方向奔跑，转弯时不再侧滑；从快速奔行减速到奔行、或从奔行减速到行走时，在半秒内平稳减速，而不是瞬间降速。超写实：在写实的基础上，自由奔跑时（未锁定敌人、不在战斗中），起步加速所需时间延长一半，身体转向更慢，最急的转弯中最多损失15%的速度，并在半秒内恢复。最高速度、停步和闪避保持不变。无：保持游戏原有设定。
